name: Andheri Subway & S.V. Road Lowlands
historical_closures_annual: 12 to 18 full closures per monsoon season
root_cause: Tidal backflow from Mogara Nullah during high sea tide (>4.5m) coinciding with rainfall >40mm/hr.
mitigation_status: BMC installed 5 dewatering pumps (6000 m3/hr capacity), but subway remains vulnerable to extreme cloudbursts.
real_estate_impact: Severe ground-floor property dampness, subterranean car park flooding, 1.5 - 2 hour traffic diversions.
citation: Moneycontrol / BMC Disaster Management Cell monsoon logs (2018-2025).

name: Kurla & Sion Chunabhatti Mithi River Basin
historical_closures_annual: Central Railway tracks submerged 8-12 days per monsoon
root_cause: Mithi river bottlenecks under CST Road Bridge and Kurla railway culverts. Encroached river channel.
mitigation_status: BRIMSTOWAD widening partially done; holding pond near Chunabhatti proposed.
real_estate_impact: Property value stagnation, structural dampness, severe vehicle damage, uninsurable basements.
citation: BRIMSTOWAD High Powered Committee Report & IIT Bombay Urban Flood Study.

name: Velachery Lakebed Inundation Zone
root_cause: Construction on natural Velachery lakebed and secondary drainage channels to Pallikaranai marsh.
mitigation_status: Greater Chennai Corporation widened Vijayanagar culvert, but secondary streets remain submerged for days.
real_estate_impact: Boats deployed for rescue; residents park cars on bypass flyovers during cyclone alerts; high rental discount in winter.
citation: Urban-Flood-Risk-Mapping (RushilGargash08) & TNGIS Velachery Drainage Vulnerability Map.

name: Pallikaranai Marsh Encroachment Fringe
elevation_delta_m: -7.0m lowest natural sink of South Chennai
root_cause: Marshland area shrunk from 5,000 hectares to under 600 hectares due to unauthorized colonisation and dumping.
mitigation_status: Madras High Court declared wetland buffer zone; strict enforcement against unauthorized building approvals.
real_estate_impact: Legal title scrutiny, high groundwater salinity (>850 ppm TDS), severe basement flooding.
citation: National Green Tribunal (NGT) Principal Bench wetland demarcation order.

name: Rainbow Drive Layout & Sarjapur Road SWD Choke
root_cause: Layout built across Halanayakanahalli lake surplus storm water drain; upstream lake overflows directly through entrance arch.
mitigation_status: BBMP reconstructed culvert across Sarjapur road, but internal villa basements remain in low-lying depression.
real_estate_impact: Severe property price correction, high legal disputes, multi-lakh monsoon drainage pumping costs.
citation: India Flood Inventory (IIT Delhi HydroSense) & BBMP Storm Water Drain Audit 2023.

name: Bellandur EcoSpace Underpass & Service Road
root_cause: K&C valley stormwater drain narrows under the Outer Ring Road service road; siltation causes reverse overflow.
mitigation_status: BBMP built elevated retaining walls and high-power diesel pumps.
real_estate_impact: 1.5 - 3 hour commute delays across entire Outer Ring Road tech corridor during 50mm+ rainfall.
citation: blr-water-log (diagram-chasing) & Bangalore Traffic Wasted Time Predictor (parthtiwari-dev).

name: Yamuna Floodplain Settlements & Mayur Vihar Lowlands
root_cause: Unauthorized construction within active river floodplains and backflow into Shahdara drain.
mitigation_status: Delhi IFCD reinforced ITO and Mayur Vihar regulator gates.
real_estate_impact: High flood hazard, structural inundation up to ground floor ceiling during release from Hathnikund Barrage.
citation: Central Water Commission (CWC) Delhi Yamuna Flood Analysis Report 2023.

name: Barapullah Phase-III 90-Degree Traffic Choke Point
historical_closures_annual: Daily peak hour speed drops to <5 km/h
root_cause: Flawed civil engineering design: multi-lane expressway merges abruptly into a 90-degree narrow exit lane at Mayur Vihar/Noida border.
mitigation_status: PWD Delhi planning redesign of cloverleaf loop; land acquisition pending.
real_estate_impact: 45-60 minutes wasted daily per commuter connecting South Delhi to East Delhi/Noida.
citation: Hindustan Times: Barapullah Phase-III Design Flaw and Traffic Bottleneck Exposure.

name: Musi River Moosarambagh & Chaderghat Lowlands
root_cause: Hydraulic release from Osmansagar and Himayatsagar dams directly floods low-lying riverbed colonies.
mitigation_status: Telangana Govt proposed Musi Riverfront Development Project; high-level bridge under construction.
real_estate_impact: Colonies evacuated during monsoon; poor sanitation, structural damage, zero institutional home loan approvals.
citation: GHMC Disaster Response & CWC Musi River Basin Flood Study.

name: Prayagraj Baghada & Salori Sangam Confluence
root_cause: Dual backwater surge: swollen Yamuna blocks Ganga outflow, causing water to pool into low-lying natural bowl colonies.
mitigation_status: Salori pumping station upgraded, but ineffective when river levels cross 84.73m danger mark.
real_estate_impact: Extreme seasonal flood avoidance; student lodges submerge up to 1st floor; heavy mud and epidemic risk.
citation: IIT Gandhinagar India Flood Atlas (wcl-iitgn) historical Doab inundation series 1901-2020.

name: Varanasi Ganga-Varuna Confluence (Sarai Mohana & Konia)
root_cause: Ganga backwaters push up the Varuna tributary for 8 km, inundating all low-lying riverbank developments.
mitigation_status: Varuna corridor embankment retaining wall partially built under Namami Gange.
real_estate_impact: Houses inundated up to 6-8 feet; heavy silt deposition; strict avoidance for residential home purchases.
citation: Varanasi City Region Flood Risk Study (ResearchGate) 1-meter DEM Varuna floodplain survey.

name: Jaunpur Gomti River Shahi Bridge Hydraulic Choke
historical_closures_annual: Flooded during intense Gomti catchment downpours
root_cause: Narrow stone arches of 16th-century Mughal Shahi Bridge obstruct swollen river flow and create 2-hour road bottlenecks.
mitigation_status: New bypass bridge operational, but inner city market streets remain bottlenecked.
real_estate_impact: High flood hazard for riverbank properties within 400m; severe commercial gridlock.
citation: IIT Delhi HydroSense (hydrosenselab) Gomti basin flood event catalog.

name: Mandovi River Estuary & Ribandar Causeway Lowlands
root_cause: Tidal backflow during spring tides (>2.8m) submerges the causeway and adjacent ground floor basements; strict CRZ-I/II non-development restrictions.
mitigation_status: WRD sluice gate upgrade ongoing; reclamation banned under Coastal Regulation Zone norms.
real_estate_impact: High corrosion of coastal structures, non-regularized illegal constructions facing NGT notices.

name: Buddha Nullah Industrial Low-Lying Catchment
root_cause: Toxic dye discharge and raw effluent overflow into seasonal stream depression; heavy metal soil contamination and basement seepage.
historical_closures_annual: 8-12 days of severe seasonal flood alert
mitigation_status: Rejuvenation project under PPCB (₹650 Cr outlay); strict residential avoidance zone.
real_estate_impact: Negative property capital appreciation, contaminated groundwater (TDS > 1200 ppm, heavy lead/cadmium trace).

name: Gomti River Low-Lying Floodplain & Pipraghat Depression
key_reason: Low-lying riverbed depression outside the engineered Gomti Riverfront retaining bund; prone to seasonal flood inundation and zero drainage runoff.
avoidance_recommendation: Avoid basements and ground-floor residential plots in this unembanked floodplain zone.

name: Kukrail Nala - Old City Culvert Bottleneck (Ghaus Mohammad / Chowk)
key_reason: Inadequate cross-drainage culverts under old railway and arterial embankments causing rapid water buildup and sewer backflow into residential basements.
avoidance_recommendation: Avoid low-contour plots within 250m of the Kukrail confluence culverts.
